column2: TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", the resolver on `three.txt` (keys `⏎ n t B`): title `three.txt · file 12 of 13 · 2 of 3 conflicts open`; block 1 open, OURS and THEIRS side by side with its BASE (`one`) under them; block 2 `took theirs`, one line `two-theirs`, the key line offering only `o ours  b both`; block 3 open with its BASE (`three`); the footer says `base shown for 3 conflicts`. Judge: the taken block's closing rule carries a `┴` although that block has no two columns (finding F11, a question).

The same at 80 columns: the short title `three.txt · 2/3 open`; below 100 columns OURS, BASE and THEIRS stack one above the other instead of side by side; block 2 `took theirs`; the frame ends at line 15 (`c4`), block 3 below the fold, then the footer line.

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", every-whole-file-shape: `theirs-deleted.txt` (we changed it, the branch deleted it) opens as a card, not a document. Title `theirs-deleted.txt · file 11 of 13` — **no conflict count** on a card (fix F8; it said `0 of 0 conflicts open` before). Then `deleted by them · o keeps the file  t deletes it`, the file's one line `changed by us, deleted by them` numbered 1, no OURS/THEIRS halves; the hint bar has no `b` and no `B`.
The same card at 80 columns: the title is the path alone, `theirs-deleted.txt` (it said `0/0 open` before fix F8).

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", whole-file-card-glimpses-a-large-file: `theirs-deleted.txt` grown to 600 lines, `G` pressed: the card shows lines up to 500 and stops; the last row is the **unnumbered** note `… first 500 lines of 8.1 KB · e opens the whole file`. Title `theirs-deleted.txt · file 11 of 13`, no count.
The same at 80 columns: lines 482–500, then the same unnumbered note row; the title is the path alone.

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", binary-card-shows-its-size: `pic.bin`, changed on both sides, opens as a card — `both modified · o keeps ours  t keeps theirs` — and in place of its bytes one unnumbered note row, `binary · 22 B`. No byte of the file is drawn. Title `pic.bin · file 10 of 13`, no count (fix F8).
The same binary card at 80 columns: the title is `pic.bin` alone (it said `0/0 open` before fix F8).

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", merge-resolved-with-the-keys: `three.txt`, `o` on block 1, then `⏎` with two blocks still open: nothing is staged, and the footer says `2 conflicts still open in three.txt · n next`. Block 1 reads `took ours` with one line `one-ours`; blocks 2 and 3 open; title `2 of 3 conflicts open`. (Taken in the `crlf-and-no-final-newline-survive` run: a capture replays its scenario's setup, and the merge scenario now begins its merge in the app.)
The same refusal at 80 columns: `2 conflicts still open in three.txt · n next` on the last row, title `three.txt · 2/3 open`.

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", kill-9-mid-rebase-then-relaunch: the capture run took `o` on the first block of `shared.txt`, was sent **SIGKILL** (the script's log: `died on signal 9`, `.git/rebase-merge present: True`), and this is the real `graft` binary relaunched on what it left: `REBASING step 1 of 2` in the header, the line `rebase still in progress from a previous run · ⏎ resolve  c continue  a abort`, the changes pane on `CONFLICTS (1)` `shared.txt`, whose diff shows **one** marker block left (the other was taken before the kill).

The same relaunch at 80 columns: the changes pane is the whole screen (the Detail tab), `REBASING step 1 of 2` on the top row, `CONFLICTS (1)` `shared.txt` with the one marker block left, and on the bottom row the line `rebase still in progress from a previous run · ⏎ resolve  c continue  a abort` (fix F9 — below 100 columns this row drew only the banner's keys before).

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", rebase-stops-twice-resolved-twice: on the first stop `⏎` on the banner, `t`, `⏎`: the resolver closes to the banner, and the line reads `all conflicts resolved · c continue ✓`; the changes pane shows `STAGED (1)` `shared.txt`, no CONFLICTS section.
The same end state at 80 columns: `STAGED (1)` `shared.txt`, no CONFLICTS section, and on the bottom row `all conflicts resolved · c continue ✓` (fix F9 — the row drew only the banner's keys before).

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", n-past-the-last-block-says-no-more (m6-conflicts/15): every other file done, `zdiff3.txt` the only one open; `t` then `n`: the notice under the title says `all blocks taken · ⏎ marks zdiff3.txt done`, the footer `no more conflicts · ⏎ marks zdiff3.txt done`; the cursor stays on the one block, which reads `took theirs · feature`. The user decides that wording.
The same at 80 columns: `no more conflicts · ⏎ marks zdiff3.txt done` on the last row, `all blocks taken · ⏎ marks zdiff3.txt done` under the title.

TESTING.md "Conflicts walk", start-over-brings-the-markers-back — `d` on `both.txt` opens a box over the resolver titled `Start both.txt over?` with `the conflict comes back with all its markers`, `takes and edits in this file are lost · not undoable while the merge is open`, `git checkout --merge -- both.txt`, and `▸[ Cancel ]   [ Start over ]`, Cancel selected (fix F10 — the box was live but never drawn). The bottom row is the box's own keys and nothing else: `←/→ move  ⏎ choose  esc cancel` (rulings 07b Q1 — it offered the resolver's keys, which the box swallows).

The same box at 80 columns, over the stacked OURS/THEIRS halves: the rows it stands on are blank from the left edge to the right (rulings 07b Q2, ADR-0040 — `▏ THEIRS` and the block's closing rule showed cut off at its edges before), and the bottom row is `←/→ move  ⏎ choose  esc cancel`.
Ticket 17, before `T`: the resolver on `notes.txt`; the bar offers `O/T` and `j/k` (bare at 120). Colour unverified.
The same at 200 columns: `O/T file`, `⏎ done`, `j/k file` in full.

Ticket 17: `T` on `notes.txt` settles the whole file and moves on — strip `notes.txt · done ✓` with `▸ gone.txt`, identity row `▸ gone.txt · modified on yours · main, deleted on theirs · feature`, notice `notes.txt done ✓ · ▸ gone.txt`. After `PgUp` (changes nothing, clears the stage's status line), the bottom row is the card's bar: `o`/`t`, no `O/T`, no `j/k`. Colour unverified.
The same steps at 200 columns: side list `…tes.txt  done ✓`, identity row, notice, and the card's bar with no `O/T` or `j/k`.

the uncommitted row has no `space fold` — changed by M6 (a6a47ee): on the uncommitted-changes row the hint ladder no longer offers `space fold` (`space` now needs a commit row, `NEEDS_A_COMMIT` in graft-ui hints.rs); every other rung as the M5 sheet showed it.
the uncommitted row has no `space fold` — the cursor on the uncommitted-changes row at 80 columns: the hint bar's keys for that row, with no `space fold`.
the uncommitted row has no `space fold` — the same at 120 columns.
the uncommitted row has no `space fold` — the same at 160 columns.

the status line on the 80-column Detail tab — changed by M6 (fix F9): in the `80x24 · username` frame the bottom row reads `push main → origin/main · esc cancels`, the push the question belongs to, where it drew the changes pane's keys, which the prompt swallows; the two 120x40 frames are unchanged.
